Fanny Stollár (born 12 November 1998) is a Hungarian tennis player.
She reached her best doubles ranking of No. 25 in the WTA rankings on 13 October 2025. Stollár has won five doubles titles on the WTA Tour and four doubles titles on the WTA Challenger Tour , along with two singles and 15 doubles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit . On 19 November 2018, she peaked at No. 114 in singles. Playing for Hungary Fed Cup team , Stollár has a win–loss record of 11–2 (as of June 2025). Career [ edit ] 2015: Junior Wimbledon doubles champion [ edit ] In 2015, Stollár won the Wimbledon girls' doubles title, partnering Dalma Gálfi .
